shared_elements: outline-drawn representational imagery on a vertical surface
justification: A shows an elaborately costumed standing anthropomorphic figure with headdress, ornaments, staff and beaded jewellery rendered in dense fine linear detail, while B shows a bare vertical slab bearing a few isolated quadruped animals in low-relief profile, one above another, with no human figure or ornament. The only correspondence is the generic use of profile representational figures on a vertical field, which any tradition could produce independently.
